subject: sarf
definition: A verb that asks the person addressed to do something. It is made from the present tense of the second person.
explanation: From تَنْصُرُ (you help), drop the tāʾ and give the end a sukūn: نْصُرْ. A word cannot begin with a sukūn, so a hamza is put in front with the vowel of the ʿayn: اُنْصُرْ. From تَضْرِبُ comes اِضْرِبْ, from تَفْتَحُ comes اِفْتَحْ.
The imperative is mabnī, usually on sukūn (اُنْصُرْ), and has six forms, for those addressed: اُنْصُرْ، اُنْصُرَا، اُنْصُرُوا، اُنْصُرِي، اُنْصُرَا، اُنْصُرْنَ.
